title: Standard US letter grade scale
description: The most common US mapping from percentage grades to letters and 4.0-scale GPA points. Individual schools and instructors may set different cutoffs and rounding policies; the syllabus always wins.
notes: Some institutions cap the scale at A (no A+) or treat A+ as 4.3.
Rounding at cutoffs (e.g., whether 89.5 becomes an A-) is instructor policy, not part of the scale.
